description:
Escape into 24 original vintage botanical greenhouse plants with brass fixtures illustrations designed for relaxed, unhurried coloring.

Each page is bold-outlined and printed single-sided on its own sheet — no color bleed-through, just room to create.

Frame the book as a "Victorian Glasshouse Botanical Journal" — each page depicts a potted specimen inside an ornate greenhouse vignette, incorporating brass fixtures (spigots, hinges, plant stands, hanging planters, thermometers, watering cans) alongside the botanicals. This gives colorists a richer scene-based composition (not just isolated plant line art), appealing to fans of steampunk/vintage aesthetics, botanical illustration, and antique conservatory decor — a distinct visual niche versus typical single-flower or generic botanical coloring pages.

Whether you're coloring to unwind after a long day or looking for a thoughtful gift, this collection offers a fresh page every time.
